headline: Marcos Accepts DICT Secretary Henry Aguda's Resignation
seoTitle: Marcos accepts DICT Secretary Henry Aguda resignation
seoDescription: President Marcos accepted DICT Secretary Henry Aguda's resignation; Aguda pledged continuity while a separate Ombudsman inquiry remains unresolved.
deck: Aguda said essential DICT functions and digital initiatives would be protected during the leadership transition.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: The resignation
paragraphs: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. confirmed that he accepted Henry Aguda's resignation as secretary of the Department of Information and Communications Technology.
Aguda had led the department since March 2025.

sections.heading: Transition at DICT
paragraphs: The Philippine News Agency reported on October 12 that Aguda pledged a smooth and orderly transition, with essential functions and ongoing digital initiatives safeguarded.
The verified source material used for this backfill did not identify a permanent successor.

sections.heading: Investigation is separate and unresolved
paragraphs: The Office of the Ombudsman was examining alleged irregularities involving government internet projects when Aguda resigned.
The existence of an investigation does not establish liability. No final finding against Aguda is reported here.

sections.heading: Why it matters to Filipinos
paragraphs: DICT oversees programs touching public connectivity, digital government and cybersecurity. An orderly handover matters to service continuity.
The next verifiable developments are the appointment of a successor, the transfer of active programs and any formal Ombudsman findings.
